status: core frozen; eleven focused tests and twenty-five independent case groups pass; root owns final integration/build/deployment checks
hypothesis: Preserve the immutable authored map and its stable IDs, and consume a strictly validated independent-prop overlay using existing static instancing, LOD, texture, toon, outline, visibility and shadow systems. Update navigation only at a committed revision; preview changes one owned instance.

document.identity: instanceId is independent from catalog assetId + exact assetVersion. Base and quest IDs cannot be shadowed or renumbered.
document.baseRevision: Deterministic FNV-1a 64-bit revision of canonical base metadata and used asset versions, for conflict detection rather than authentication.
document.basePolicy: All base rows are read-only in this MVP, with specific baked/terrain-pad reasons. Original authored source fields, IDs, x/z/yaw/scale and optional elevation are retained; their existing terrain placement loader remains authoritative.
document.validation: Reject unknown fields, invalid map/schema/base revisions, protected/duplicate/invalid IDs, nonfinite/out-of-range values, nonunit quaternions/normals, unapproved/unknown asset versions, unsupported scales and collision/surface combinations. Geometry/base64/URLs/private paths are not valid overlay fields.
document.history: PlacementHistory preserves IDs and cloned document snapshots; commit, undo and redo produce monotonically increasing revisions. Save/reopen roundtrip is validated.

runtime.resources: Only explicitly selected approved static assets load. Existing loadMapContainer/readMapContainer, decode/resource caches, prepareVillageInstancing, installVillageGeometry, VillageGeometryStreaming/VillageDemandCache, VillageTextureStreaming, VillageVisibility and VillageOutlines are reused.
runtime.quality: Initial selected near source uses villageLodSources including the existing mobile-near texture path; other geometry tiers remain lazy under existing screen-coverage demand. No existing quality/distance/LOD policy is reduced.
runtime.bounds: Full normalized quaternion and positive uniform scale apply above catalog source-unit normalization/front yaw/pivot. Actual transformed static vertices determine support contact, avoiding empty AABB-corner floating. Conservative affine mesh bounds determine culling and ground collision.
runtime.surfaces: Ground anchors verify terrain height/normal, or loaded immutable-base mesh supports. Wall/ceiling anchors require immutable base instanceId and a true local-space triangle ray intersection with signed outward normal. Overlay-on-overlay parenting is explicitly rejected. Free attachments retain no support payload.
runtime.collision: Solid is certified only for ground-attached independent props. Wall/ceiling/free decorations explicitly require collision:none, preventing phantom ground blockers below elevated props. Ground solids use a transformed-mesh conservative XZ box, including tilt/scale and full translated bounds.
runtime.navigation: A committed navigator inherits the original class/methods and cave baked clearance, merges overlay obstacle/index fields, and starts fresh path/route caches. Preview does not rebuild navigation. Map exit removes overlay obstacles/nodes and restores the exact original navigator object.
runtime.publication: Prepare a staged inactive outline owner before mutating the live document/transforms/navigation. A preparation failure retains the old document, root positions, navigation, revision and outline owner. Successful publication changes world.placementRevision, world.authoredPlacementRecords and world.placementOverlay together; onCommit receives document/records/obstacles/revision for minimap invalidation.
runtime.boundsAndCleanup: At most 128 committed instances, one preview and eight selected asset/version entries. Source references share native geometry/materials; last-owner release cancels owned waits, releases admitted high textures, then disposes source containers. Map/scene generation guards reclaim exact late results.

cases: all four base manifests and protected IDs
twenty single-instance preview transforms with one selected source and no nav/revision work
committed old/new collision/free/segment/move behavior and original navigator restoration
true box wall/ceiling support hits, outward normals and offsets
map exit during selected-source load with exact late disposal
focusedEvidence.fixtureScope: Babylon NullEngine plus actual world setup and controlled static-box sources; C owns actual packed-asset/four-map scenarios. No GPU pixels/device timing claim.

independentEvidence.coverage: Four actual maps: place/transform/history/collision/path/minimap/export/reopen/revisit, exact near/mid/far base+ink/shadow submissions, true rotated support/vertex contact, cross-cell existing preview/cancel, nonpublishing multiple visuals, preparation rollback, resource/final-owner plateau and late cancellation. Exported files applied into temporary projects and consumed by the actual game loader. Metadata-only catalog and real DOM/native Gizmo ownership/error scenarios passed.
independentEvidence.limit: NullEngine/DOM ownership and actual native CPU submissions, not browser pixels or physical-device GPU/FPS. Root camera/context bridge fixes remain subject to its final integration checks.

integrationAsks: Root owns editor/Gizmo/input/UI, minimap invalidation, local apply CLI and deployment.
Use catalog-approved handcart/firewood/crate-barrel-cluster only for this MVP; structural/baked edits stay visibly read-only.
Keep catalog/editor/runtime imports behind the explicit development entry. Normal project overlay loading must consume only the validated selected catalog subset.
Use runtime onCommit for minimap invalidation; leaveMap before replacing world/ground ownership.
Independent actual four-map save/reopen/undo/collision/resource verification remains the phase completion gate.
limitations: No browser automation or GPU visual validation.
No new geometry, paid assets, automatic reduction, combat changes or base-map edits.
No wall/ceiling solid collision, overlay support parenting, baked-wall/terrain editing, collaboration or multi-select claim.
Navigation path grids invalidate on commit and rebuild lazily under the existing navigator; there is no full-map rebuild per drag.
Preparation/model and high-texture callbacks retain the existing bounded deadlines; CPU/metadata counts are not measured GPU residency.
